bug_locations: clamp: missing required ValueError guard for low > high (previously fell through to min/max and silently returned high)
clamp: normalized the over-indented body to standard 4-space indentation
explanation: The expression min(max(x, low), high) is correct only when low <= high; when low > high it collapses to high and returns it instead of failing, violating the specification. Added an explicit guard `if low > high: raise ValueError(...)` before clamping so invalid bounds are rejected, and kept the inclusive clamping logic unchanged. The function body was also re-indented consistently; no example values were hard-coded.
